title: Private assembly of finite coefficient monoidality
statement: For the finite quotient coefficient map O_E/(varpi_E^(n+1))→O_E/(varpi_E^(m+1)) and the small etale site of a finite-type scheme X, the fixed derived scalar extension with the published tensor, unit and Koszul comparisons satisfies FiniteHomDomainMonoidal. Its finiteHomEtaleTensor agrees heterogeneously with the representative-normalized tensorIso, and the latter tensor and unit comparisons satisfy TensorNormalization and UnitNormalization [def-coef-finite-hom-monoidal-data, def-pur-exceptional-coefficient-normalizations, def-sf-etale-finite-coefficient-hom-arrow, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. This is the already proved finite monoidality specialization, placed in a private implementation module.
